block.createairspace.baggage_scanner.too: Beeps, turns its lamp _red_ and gives off a _redstone signal_. Sort the item out with Create, for example with a _brass tunnel_ or _funnel_.

An _X-ray tunnel_ for the middle of a straight _belt_, placed like a Create tunnel. It encases the belt in industrial iron and screens everything passing through, including the _contents_ of luggage and packages.
block.createairspace.cargo_container.too: Turns the _dock side_ to the next side.
Joins into one container: _1x1x2_ is an LD2, _2x2x2_ an LD3, _3x2x2_ an LD11, _3x3x3_ an AMA. Other shapes stay _loose_.
A _Physics Assembler_ takes the whole container as _one piece_, no glue needed. The floor stays behind.
When Placed in a ULD Shape
Build a _ULD_ from these blocks. Each block holds as much as an _Item Vault_ block. Only _Container Ports_ load and unload it. The _dock side_ shows a _lock point_ and _port points_.
block.createairspace.container_lock.tool: _Pulls in_ the lock point of an assembled container like a _magnet_, lines it up, _grips_ it and pushes out its _bolts_. Nothing pulls it off again.
_Lets go_ of the container. A _Comparator_ shows whether a container is locked.
Holds a cargo container. Fits _into the floor_ under it or _into the wall_ next to it. Containers _slide_ over it like over a Roller Bed.
block.createairspace.container_port.tool: Connects to a _port point_ that faces it, the _bolts_ on its sides run forward and lock in. _Funnels_, _chutes_ and other logistics at the port then _fill_ or _empty_ the container.
When a Container Is Locked in Front
Sits in the _wall_ next to a docked container, like a _Portable Storage Interface_. It is placed with its front _towards you_, sneak to turn it away.
block.createairspace.floor_light.tooltip: Switches between _always on_ and _brightness from redstone_. A _Wrench_ does the same.
_Recolours_ the light without using up the dye. _White_ resets it.
Gets _brighter_ with a _stronger signal_. Without a signal it stays _off_.
A small _light set into the floor_ that you can walk over.
block.createairspace.light_panel.tooltip: Switches between _always on_ and _brightness from redstone_. A _Wrench_ does the same.
_Recolours_ the light without using up the dye. _White_ resets it.
Gets _brighter_ with a _stronger signal_. Without a signal it stays _off_.
A _ceiling or wall light_ that joins with neighbouring panels into one _lit surface_.
block.createairspace.light_strip.tooltip: Switches between _always on_ and _brightness from redstone_. A _Wrench_ does the same.
_Recolours_ the light without using up the dye. _White_ resets it.
On _floors and ceilings_ it runs the way you are _looking_. On _walls_ it runs _horizontally_, _sneak_ while placing to run it _vertically_.
Gets _brighter_ with a _stronger signal_. Without a signal it stays _off_.
A _light band_ that joins with neighbouring strips into one _line_.
block.createairspace.metal_detector.tool: Beeps, turns its lamp _red_ and gives off a _redstone signal_ for two seconds. What counts is the item tag _createairspace:security_alarm_.
A _walk-through frame_ that checks everyone passing through for _weapons and metal_, also inside luggage and packages.
Shows _white_ to pilots above its angle and _red_ to pilots below it. Every player sees the color of their _own approach_.
Set on the _back_ like other Create values. A new light next to a row gets the next lower angle, so start with the one _next to the runway_.
One light of a _PAPI_, a landing aid. Set four in a row next to the runway, the _lens facing the approach_.
A floor of _steel balls_. _Physics objects_ such as assembled cargo containers _slide_ over it, players and mobs keep their grip.
block.createairspace.roller_floor.toolti: Moves _physics objects_ like cargo containers across it in the direction its rollers turn. Two networks at once move them _diagonally_. Players, mobs and items are not moved.

A _powered_ roller floor for cargo. It has _shafts on all four sides_: west and east drive one network, north and south a second, independent one. All floors joined into an area share both networks and pass rotation on.
Two _yellow lamps_ in front of a runway that flash in turns, a warning for anyone about to enter it.
block.createairspace.stop_bar.tooltip.be: The _whole bar_ goes dark and the aircraft may cross.
block.createairspace.stop_bar.tooltip.su: Red _inset lights_ across a taxiway that tell aircraft to _hold_. Placed next to each other they form one _bar_.
createairspace.barrier_post.blocks_inval: Barrier Post blocks invalid, Sneak-click to reset
createairspace.barrier_post.cannot_add_m: Cannot add more connections to this Barrier Post
createairspace.barrier_post.select_secon: Select a second Barrier Post to connect
createairspace.luggage_scale.title: Luggage Scale
createairspace.ponder.airfield_sign.head: Writing on Airfield Signs
createairspace.ponder.airfield_sign.text: Right-click with a named Name Tag or a Clipboard to write on a row of signs
Display Links can write on them as well
Use a Wrench on the front to switch between location, direction and mandatory signs
createairspace.ponder.airport_beacon.tex: Rotational force from below turns the head of the beacon
The light is controlled by redstone from the sides. Stronger signals make it brighter and reach further
Use a Wrench to switch between the patterns of land airports, water airports, heliports and military airports
createairspace.ponder.barrier_post.text_: Right-click two Barrier Posts with a Wrench to connect them
The distance between two posts is limited
A post can hold multiple connections, which is great for queue lines
Right-click a belt with a dye to change its color
Sneak-right-click a belt with a Wrench to remove it
createairspace.ponder.cargo_container.te: Cargo Container blocks join into a container once they form a ULD shape
Container Ports in the wall connect to the port points of a locked container in front of them
Like a Portable Storage Interface, funnels, chutes and other logistics at the port then fill or empty the container
1x1x2 is an LD2, 2x2x2 an LD3, 3x2x2 an LD11 and 3x3x3 an AMA. Each block holds as much as an Item Vault
The dock side faces you when you place the last block. It shows the lock point and the port points
A Wrench turns the dock side
A Physics Assembler takes the whole container as one piece, no glue needed
Roller Beds let containers and other physics objects slide, players keep their grip
A Container Lock fits into the floor or the wall
It pulls in the lock point of an assembled container like a magnet, lines it up and grips it. Nothing pulls it off again
A redstone signal at the lock lets go of the container
createairspace.ponder.edge_light.text_1: Edge Lights light up when they receive a redstone signal
createairspace.ponder.edge_light.text_2: Redstone dust connects to them, so one line can power a whole row
createairspace.ponder.edge_light.text_3: Use dye to change the color: white, blue, green, red or yellow
createairspace.ponder.luggage_scale.head: Weighing Luggage
createairspace.ponder.luggage_scale.text: Right-click with a piece of luggage to put it on the scale. The screen shows its weight
Blocks inside count with their mass, other items by how full their stack is
Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take it off again
Placed between belts, luggage rolls across and stops in the middle to be weighed
Above 23 kg the weight turns red
Comparators read the weight: 0 at the minimum, 15 at the maximum, evenly in between. A Nixie Tube shows the signal
Right-click with an empty hand to set the minimum and maximum weight
createairspace.ponder.papi_light.header: Guiding the Approach with PAPI Lights
createairspace.ponder.papi_light.text_1: PAPI Lights stand in a row of four next to the runway, their lenses facing the approaching aircraft
createairspace.ponder.papi_light.text_2: They light up while powered by redstone
createairspace.ponder.papi_light.text_3: Coming in too high, a pilot sees all four lights white
createairspace.ponder.papi_light.text_4: On the glide path, the two lights next to the runway turn red and the other two stay white
createairspace.ponder.papi_light.text_5: Too low, and all four are red
createairspace.ponder.papi_light.text_6: Each light changes color at its own angle, set on the back of its housing. A light placed next to a row takes the next lower angle, so start next to the runway
createairspace.ponder.papi_light.text_7: Every player sees the colors of their own position
createairspace.ponder.roller_floor.heade: Moving Cargo with Motorized Roller Floors
createairspace.ponder.roller_floor.text_: Motorized Roller Floors have shafts on all four sides. West and east belong to one network, north and south to a second, independent one
Joined floors turn together and pass the rotation on, just like shafts
Physics objects like cargo containers move the way the rollers turn. Players, mobs and items stay where they are
The second network moves them the other way across. With both turning they travel diagonally
Unlike Roller Beds they are not slippery, a container stops as soon as the rollers stop
createairspace.ponder.runway_marking.tex: Paint Pails hold white or yellow paint. Fill them with a Spout or from a tank
Right-click the ground to paint. Lines run in the direction you look
Sneak and right-click to switch the pattern. Painting over a marking replaces it
The Number pattern paints a whole 2 x 3 character at once
Right-click a number with a Wrench to switch the character: 0 to 9, L, R and C
Paint does not come back when a marking is removed
createairspace.ponder.security_scanner.t: The Baggage Scanner goes on the middle of a straight belt like a tunnel. It encases the belt and screens everything passing through
Luggage and packages are screened together with their contents
If it finds weapons or metal, it beeps and gives off a redstone signal for two seconds
Sorting the luggage out is left to Create, for example with a brass tunnel or a funnel
The Metal Detector checks everyone who walks through it, with their whole inventory
Both react to the item tag createairspace:security_alarm, which datapacks can extend
createairspace.ponder.stop_bar.text_1: Stop Bars are red inset lights across a taxiway. While they are lit, aircraft have to hold
createairspace.ponder.stop_bar.text_2: A redstone signal into any of them switches off the whole bar, and the aircraft may cross
createairspace.ponder.stop_bar.text_3: Runway Guard Lights flash yellow in turns while powered, a warning in front of a runway
createairspace.ponder.tag.airport_access: Blocks to build and decorate your airport
createairspace.ponder.windsock.text_1: Windsocks always point in the direction the wind is blowing
createairspace.ponder.windsock.text_2: The stronger the wind, the higher the sock flies. Rain, thunderstorms and height make it stronger
